metaDescription: Check .gitlab-ci.yml for YAML errors, jobs without script, unknown stages, broken needs and extends. Free and offline, no GitLab login needed.
intro: Checks the structure of a .gitlab-ci.yml: YAML syntax, jobs, stages, needs, extends, when values and keywords outside the documented list.
why:
GitLab's own CI lint needs a project and a login. This page gives a quick structural check you can run on any file, for example while reviewing a merge request.

It flags clear mistakes as problems and doubtful ones as review items. It cannot see include files, variables, rules logic or runner settings, so a pass here is not a pass in GitLab. Keyword names come from the GitLab CI/CD YAML reference.
howTo: Read the Problems list first, then the Review list.
Fix the file and paste again.
Run GitLab's own CI lint for the final check.

faq.q: Does it replace GitLab's CI lint?
faq.a: No. It checks structure only. It does not fetch includes, expand variables or evaluate rules.

faq.q: Why is a keyword marked for review?
faq.a: It is not in the documented job keyword list. It may be a typo, or a newer keyword than this list.

faq.q: Are only and except an error?
faq.a: No. They are reported for review because GitLab recommends rules for new pipelines.
